title: pickled.yml
description: Configuration for testing whether agents understand a product. Editor/tooling contract; the pickled loader remains the authoritative validator (it owns cross-references, reserved names, and provider-specific rules).

threshold.description: Optional run score required for the run to pass. Omit to report the score with no pass/fail verdict.

product.description: Name and describe the product being tested.

name.description: Product name shown in prompts and reports.

description.description: Short product description used to orient the agent.
examples: A CLI for managing cloud deployments

sources.description: Named context artifacts Pickled can inject or point agents toward.

additionalProperties.description: A URL or local file path.

provider.description: Agent provider or interface to run.

model.description: Model identifier to run. Pin a specific version; aliases can drift across SDK upgrades.

maxTokens.description: Maximum response tokens for API agents.

maxTurns.description: Maximum turns for CLI agents that support a turn cap.

agents.description: Agents or model interfaces that answer each question.

headers.description: Optional HTTP headers for the MCP server. ${VAR} values are expanded from the environment by the loader.

source.description: A registered source id, or "none" for no context.

tools.description: How the agent reaches context: none injects the source, web uses web search, mcp uses the declared MCP servers.

servers.description: MCP servers for this access path. Required when tools is mcp, forbidden otherwise.

access.description: Named paths that say how an agent reaches context: a (source, tools) pair.

checks.description: The answer contract for a question. At least one check is required.

mustMention.description: Case-sensitive substrings that must all appear in the answer.

mustMentionOneOf.description: Groups where the answer must include at least one value from each group.

label.description: Human-readable name for this one-of group, shown in receipts.

values.description: Candidate substrings; at least one must appear.

mustNotMention.description: Case-sensitive substrings that must not appear in the answer.

examples.description: Offline sample answers checked by pickled test (no model calls).

pass.description: Answers that should satisfy every check.

fail.description: Answers that should fail at least one check.

workspace.description: Build tasks only: the throwaway fixture the agent edits.

path.description: Fixture directory the agent edits, relative to pickled.yml.

setup.description: Commands run to prepare the fixture before the agent.

task.description: An intent a developer cares about. Answer tasks prove success with text checks; build tasks edit a workspace and run verify. Field separation (checks vs workspace/verify) is enforced by the loader.

id.description: Stable task id used in reports and CLI filters (--task).

prompt.description: The question to answer, or the work to build.

kind.description: How success is proven. "answer" (default): deterministic text checks. "build": edit the workspace and pass verify commands.

agents.description: Agent names declared in the top-level agents map.

access.description: Access path names declared in the top-level access map.

verify.description: Build tasks only: commands that must pass after the agent stops.

trials.description: Build tasks only: independent trials per cell (default 1).

tasks.description: Tasks for agents: answer tasks (text checks) and build tasks (edit a workspace, run verify).
